upload.title: 스무 해 회사를 떠나던 날, 아빠가 찾은 진짜 자리 | 쓸모없는 나무 #shorts
upload.description:
박스 하나에 담긴 스무 해.
엘리베이터 문이 닫히는 동안, 아무도 내 이름을 부르지 않았다.

장자는 말했습니다. 쓸모없는 나무는 베어 가는 이가 없어 오래 산다고.
회사에서 쓸모가 다한 날, 나는 비로소 아이들의 그늘이 되었습니다.

🎵 쓸모없는 나무 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 당신에게 '두 번째 시작'은 언제였나요? 댓글로 들려주세요. 다음 노래가 됩니다.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

#퇴사 #희망퇴직 #아빠 #가장 #인생2막 #위로 #직장인공감 #장자 #MIDLIFECOMMUTER #shorts

shots.plate: a quiet Korean open-plan office in the evening, rows of desks with monitors, one cleared desk in front with a cardboard box holding a mug and a framed family photo, warm desk lamp light, blue dusk through big windows
shots.motion: the man stands beside the cleared desk and looks down at the cardboard box with a quiet sigh, the desk lamp glows, dusk light slowly fades outside the windows

shots.plate: a big office window high in a Seoul office tower at dusk, the city skyline with lights turning on, a purple and orange sky, empty desks behind
shots.motion: the man gazes out of the window at the city, the city lights twinkle on one by one, clouds drift slowly across the dusk sky

shots.plate: a long aisle between office desks in a Korean company in the evening, monitors glowing, papers and files on desks, fluorescent ceiling lights
shots.motion: the man walks slowly down the aisle, the seated office workers keep typing at their monitors without looking up, a monitor flickers
shots.extras: office workers sitting at their desks on both sides, heads down, typing and looking at their monitors, nobody looking up

shots.plate: close view of an office desk corner in the evening, a cardboard box with a white mug, a framed family photo of a smiling mother and two children, and a few business cards, warm lamp light, in present-day South Korea
shots.motion: the man looks down at the small thing in his hands with a faint sad smile, the lamp light flickers softly, dust floats in the light

shots.plate: inside a small stainless steel elevator car of a Korean office building, narrow box-shaped cabin, a mirrored back wall, a button panel with glowing floor numbers on the side wall, handrail, soft ceiling light
shots.motion: the man stands still in the small elevator and slowly lowers his head, the floor numbers on the button panel blink as they count down, the ceiling light glows softly

shots.plate: the glass entrance of a tall Seoul office building at dusk, a wide plaza in front, street lamps turning on, a blue evening sky
shots.motion: the man walks slowly away from the building across the plaza, the office workers hurry past him without looking, the street lamps glow
shots.extras: office workers in coats hurrying past across the plaza, talking on phones, a security guard standing by the glass doors

shots.plate: a huge old crooked zelkova tree with a thick twisted trunk and wide gnarled branches in a small Korean neighbourhood park on a hill, a low stone wall around its roots, golden sunset sky, apartment buildings far behind
shots.motion: the man stands still and gazes up at the giant crooked tree with a calm face, the leaves sway gently in the evening wind, golden light flickers through the branches

shots.plate: a wide view of a huge old crooked zelkova tree on a small hill park at sunset, a traditional wooden pavilion (jeongja) beside it, a dirt path, warm golden light, in present-day South Korea
shots.motion: an old couple standing under the tree chat and laugh together, the old man nods kindly at the man, the man smiles back, leaves sway and fall slowly

shots.plate: under the wide spreading branches of a huge old crooked tree, dappled late afternoon sunlight on green grass, a quiet Korean neighbourhood park
shots.motion: the man stands in the shade of the tree and takes a deep calm breath, his face relaxes into a gentle smile, sunlight flickers through the leaves

shots.plate: a picnic mat spread on the grass in the deep shade under a huge old crooked tree, a picnic basket and fruit on the mat, a sunny Korean park in the afternoon
shots.motion: the two children laugh and play in the cool shade, the wife smiles at her husband, the man watches his family happily, leaves sway above them

shots.plate: the gate of a Korean elementary school on a sunny weekday afternoon, a schoolyard and a red brick school building behind, cherry trees along the fence
shots.motion: the little girl waves happily at her father and skips toward him, the father opens his arms with a big smile, children play in the schoolyard behind
shots.extras: a few schoolchildren with backpacks in the schoolyard far behind, a crossing guard grandmother in a yellow vest by the gate

shots.plate: a warm cozy Korean apartment kitchen and dining area in the evening, a dining table set with steaming rice bowls, stew and side dishes, warm pendant light
shots.motion: the family gathers around the dinner table, steam rises from the stew, the wife laughs and the children cheer, the man smiles warmly at them

shots.plate: a huge old crooked tree in a small park in front of a Korean apartment complex at blue dusk, warm yellow lights glowing in many apartment windows, a big full moon in a deep blue sky, soft street lamp light on the path
shots.motion: the man stands still under the big tree and smiles gently, the leaves rustle softly, the apartment windows glow warmly, the moon shines
